steps.title: Pick up twigs, grass and flint as you walk
steps.instructions: Pull [[Twigs]] from small saplings and [[Cut Grass]] from grass tufts. [[Flint]] is the sharp grey stone lying on the ground. Aim for about 10 of each.

steps.title: Craft an Axe and chop trees
steps.instructions: An [[Axe]] costs 1 Twigs and 1 Flint. Chop a few trees until you have at least 10 [[Log|Logs]].

steps.title: Craft a Pickaxe and mine boulders
steps.instructions: A [[Pickaxe]] costs 2 Twigs and 2 Flint. Boulders give [[Rocks]] and more Flint. Boulders with yellow veins also drop a [[Gold Nugget]], which you need tomorrow.

steps.title: Grab food on the way
steps.instructions: Pick [[Berries]] from bushes and pull [[Carrot|Carrots]] out of the ground. Eat when the stomach meter gets low, not before.

steps.title: Light a Campfire before it gets dark
steps.instructions: Standing in total darkness kills you. When the screen turns dusky, build a [[Campfire]] (2 Logs and 3 Cut Grass) and stay beside it until morning. Add Logs to keep it burning.

steps.title: Keep a Torch ready
steps.instructions: A [[Torch]] costs 2 Cut Grass and 2 Twigs. It is your emergency light if night catches you away from a fire.

steps.title: Find a Gold Nugget
steps.instructions: If you did not get a [[Gold Nugget]] yesterday, look for boulders with yellow veins in rocky areas and mine them.

steps.title: Build a Science Machine
steps.instructions: The [[Science Machine]] costs 1 Gold Nugget, 4 Logs and 4 Rocks. Stand next to it to unlock new recipes.

steps.title: Make a Backpack
steps.instructions: A [[Backpack]] costs 4 Cut Grass and 4 Twigs and gives you extra inventory slots. Craft it at the Science Machine.

steps.title: Craft a Shovel
steps.instructions: A [[Shovel]] costs 2 Twigs and 2 Flint. You will use it later to dig up bushes and move them near your camp.

steps.title: Choose a place for your camp
steps.instructions: Pick a spot close to grass, saplings and berry bushes. Build your next Science Machine and fire there so you stop carrying everything.

steps.title: Turn grass into Rope and logs into Boards
steps.instructions: [[Rope]] costs 3 Cut Grass and [[Boards]] cost 4 Logs. Most tools and buildings from here on need them.

steps.title: Craft a Spear and a Log Suit
steps.instructions: A [[Spear]] (2 Twigs, 1 Rope, 1 Flint) lets you fight back. A [[Log Suit]] (8 Logs, 2 Rope) absorbs most of the damage you take.

steps.title: Build a Chest
steps.instructions: A [[Chest]] costs 3 Boards. Store spare materials in it so your inventory stays free.

steps.title: Set Traps for rabbits
steps.instructions: A [[Trap]] costs 6 Cut Grass and 2 Twigs. Place it on top of a rabbit hole and come back later for meat.

steps.title: Cook your food
steps.instructions: Hold raw food over the fire to cook it. Cooked food restores more and some raw food hurts you.

steps.title: Stock up on fuel
steps.instructions: Keep at least 10 [[Log|Logs]] and a stack of [[Cut Grass]] in a chest so you can always make a fire at night.

steps.title: Build a Drying Rack
steps.instructions: A [[Drying Rack]] costs 3 Twigs, 2 Charcoal and 3 Rope. It turns meat into food that lasts a long time. [[Charcoal]] comes from burnt trees.

steps.title: Move bushes and saplings to your camp
steps.instructions: Use the [[Shovel]] to dig up berry bushes, grass tufts and saplings, then replant them next to camp for a steady supply.

steps.title: Build an Alchemy Engine
steps.instructions: The [[Alchemy Engine]] unlocks the next tier of recipes, including better armour and winter gear.

steps.title: Get ready for a hound attack
steps.instructions: Hounds attack after roughly a week. Keep your [[Spear]] and [[Log Suit]] in your inventory, not in a chest.

steps.title: Start planning for winter
steps.instructions: Winter starts around day 21 and the cold kills. A [[Thermal Stone]] (10 Rocks, 1 Pickaxe, 3 Flint) is the first thing to make.
